name: Medical Device Software Engineer
description: Develop safety-critical software for medical devices. Follow FDA/IEC 62304 standards, implement real-time monitoring, and ensure fail-safe operation.
example_snippet:
program PatientMonitor:
    shape VitalSigns holds:
        HeartRate as whole number
        SpO2 as whole number
        BloodPressureSys as whole number
        BloodPressureDia as whole number
        AlarmLevel as whole number
    end shape

    action check_alarms takes V as const ref VitalSigns produces whole number:
        if V.HeartRate is less than 60 then:
            produce success with 2
        end if
        if V.SpO2 is less than 90 then:
            produce success with 3
        end if
        produce success with 0
    end action

    keep Patient1 as VitalSigns with 55 and 98 and 120 and 80 and 0
    keep Alarm as whole number
    call check_alarms with Patient1 giving Alarm
    print the text "Alarm level: " and Alarm and newline
end program
